scenes.audio: If you throw ten thousand times, you'll hit it once, right? It's exactly the same as sales. So, action is the fundamental root of a salesperson. Let me give you another piece of data, okay? This will be very useful for you.

scenes.audio: How can drinking this medicine cure cancer? You think it's impossible, right? In your mind, you think how is it possible? Everyone, is it possible? Do they make a lot of money? Yes. Back to yourselves, if you just meet one hundred prospects, there will always be twenty customers who believe you.
